title: Kachumber Salad
description: A crunchy, no-cook salad of finely diced cucumber, tomato and onion, dressed simply with lemon and salt — the everyday table side.
steps: Combine the diced cucumber, tomato and onion in a mixing bowl.
Add the green chilli and coriander leaves.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the vegetables and season with salt and roasted cumin powder if using.
Toss everything together just before serving so the vegetables stay crisp and don't release too much water.
